'''Joe Kwiatek''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Belle Mead tournament]] on 31 March 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG]] and EBOX, according to Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1994">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-belle-mead-new-jersey-03-31-01d1994/ belle-mead-new-jersey-03-31-01], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 1 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-belle-mead-new-jersey-03-31-01d1994/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
